topic: Chang'e 4 cotton sprout on the Moon
hook: Your cotton seed sprouted on the Moon's far side.
title: A Cotton Plant Sprouted on the Moon
description:
In 2019, China's Chang'e 4 lander carried cotton seeds to the far side of the Moon. One sprouted inside a sealed canister, the first plant to sprout on the Moon. The freezing lunar night later ended the experiment. Part of the series If You Were in Space.

#Shorts #Space #Moon
